title: Hanyoyi masu aminci: tsarin aminci, guntu mai kauri da bushewa mai tsabta

say: Hanyoyi masu aminci: tsarin aminci, guntu masu tsinke, da bushewa mai tsabta.
Wannan bidiyon ne don Module 2 na Ƙaramin-Sarancin Abinci.
Hukumar Lafiya ta Duniya ta ba da maɓalli biyar don samun ingantaccen abinci. Na farko, kiyaye tsabta. Wanke hannu da kayan aiki, kuma a kiyaye kwari, beraye da dabbobi.

panel.rule: Iyakar da ba za ku iya aunawa ba iyaka.

say: Misali, Halima a Kaduna tana yin man gyada. Babban haɗarinta shine aflatoxin, gubar da aka yi mata. Gasasshen ba ya lalata shi da dogaro, kuma bayyanar dogon lokaci yana da alaƙa da ciwon hanta.
Don haka mahimmancin ikonta yana warwarewa. Iyakar ta: babu gyale, yayyage ko launin goro, kuma babu duwatsu. Idan mold ya yadu, an ƙi dukan kuri'a.

cards.d: Babu ƙwaya mai gyaɗa ko gyaɗa ko launin fata kuma babu duwatsu. Yana duba kowane tire da ido.
Fasa ƴan ƙwaya a buɗe: gasassu ko'ina, bushe da crunchy ko'ina.
Ya duba injin ɗin da aka raba yana da tsabta, yana gudanar da ɗan hannu kaɗan kafin ya jefar da shi.

say: Yin bushewa a ƙasa maras tushe yana barin ƙura, duwatsu, ɗigon ruwa da kwari, da bushewa a hankali a cikin yanayin ɗanɗano yana gayyatar mold.

say: Yi amfani da tarkacen ɗagawa wanda aka lulluɓe da gidan yanar gizo, ko busar da hasken rana. Ki zuba abinci a cikin siraran sirara daya, sai ki juye kullum, sannan ki rufe da daddare kafin ruwan sama.

say: A fara sanyi, sannan a gwada. Yankuna yakamata su ɗauka. Sa'an nan kuma rufe hannun hannu a cikin busasshen kwalba na yini ɗaya. Droplets yana nufin ƙarin bushewa.
Misali, Grace ta kilogiram 5 na sabo da barkono ya bushe ya kai kimanin kilogiram 0.6. Ki shirya da zarar ya huce, ki ajiye shi a ƙasa, kuma kada ku ƙara maganin kwari a cikin abincin da aka adana.

say: Don tunawa. Bi maɓallan biyar. Ba kowane muhimmin batu iyaka, cak, gyara da rikodin. Sarrafa aflatoxin ta hanyar rarrabawa da bushewar ajiya. Soya a daidai zafin jiki da sanyi kafin rufewa. Kuma bushe abinci daga ƙasa, sa'an nan gwada shi.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Tsaftace, raba, dafa, yanayin zafi mai aminci, ruwa mai lafiya
CCP yana buƙatar iyaka, dubawa, gyara da rikodi
Aflatoxin: ware da kyau kuma adana bushewa
Gasa a 160 C zuwa 180 C kuma kwantar da hankali kafin rufewa
bushe daga ƙasa; gwajin karye da gwajin jar

say: Yanzu rubuta tsarin tsaro na shafi ɗaya, soya ɗan ƙaramin gwajin gwaji kuma yi rikodin nauyinsa, sannan a bushe samfurin ɗaya, sannan a duba shi kowane mako har tsawon makonni huɗu.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
